environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API type). Session cookies use SameSite=None with Secure flag for cross-origin mobile app compatibility. No custom request filters or CORS restrictions configured. API Gateway has no WAF association. The settings.html Qute template loads form-validation.js from CDN without integrity attributes. Content-Security-Policy header is not set.
